critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck cylinder along its longitudinal axis to increase total length by 150%. Simultaneously, increase the cylinder's radius by 20% and apply a fillet or bevel of 30 degrees to the leading edge where it meets the cockpit. This will ensure the hump extends significantly further back along the fuselage while maintaining a wider profile and smoother aerodynamic transition.

discrepancies.observed: A very short hump that ends almost immediately behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck cylinder

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively low and blends into the main fuselage quickly.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, high-profile upper deck that stands out clearly from the main body.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical height of the upper-deck geometry

discrepancies.observed: An abrupt transition between the cockpit area and the hump.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous aerodynamic curve transitioning into the upper deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: smooth/round the front edge of the hump cylinder

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears narrow compared to the main fuselage diameter.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck has a wider profile that maintains more volume as it recedes.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase radius of the upper-deck cylinder
